input.command: for f in README.md store.py setup.py tests/test_setup.py .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; git show :$f; done; echo "=== cleanup.py (index)"; git show :cleanup.py; echo "=== HEAD cleanup"; git show HEAD:cleanup.py; git diff --quiet -- cleanup.py && echo "worktree==index"
input.description: Read index versions of all repo files
